dataset: City of Palo Alto Electric Vehicle Charging Station Usage (July 2011 - Dec 2020)
regression_target: next exact-hour station energy (kWh); 0 if no charging session
classification_target: next-hour ChargePoint server-termination proxy derived from the source `Ended By` field; it is not a ground-truth hardware failure label
leakage_guard: current_server_termination_count and next_hour_server_termination_count are retained for audit only and are excluded from all model feature lists
weather_note: The provided City ChargePoint CSV has no weather columns. Weather is not fabricated. The real-data model uses charging-session, time, port, fee and geography features.
